items.title: In a clash of the top two, should Chelsea be considered underdogs?
items.description: To consider Chelsea as underdogs in domestic competition feels alien. To a club so endowed with silverware and success over such a long period, it's like a dirty word. Something reserved for opponents, not them.

items.title: Man City are 'messier', but are they more dangerous than ever?
